<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/sigmafi/claims/{tokenId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}

Take everything the vault holds for a bond asset this wallet holds, burning the asset. Every vault box for it is claimed at once: once the asset is burned, nothing left behind can be claimed. Refused while a pending transaction still pays into the vault for it.
